children: China's industrial production likely grew in August, according to BofA Securities in a research note. Industrial production likely edged up to 4.7% year-over-year in August from 4.5% in July, the bank says. This is reflected in the official manufacturing PMI production index, which returned to expansion as extreme-weather disruptions eased, the bank says. "Continued strength in high-tech and equipment manufacturing likely supported activity, although weak mining and basic-materials production capped the recovery," BofA says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
